digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py both exceed or meet the 800 LOC CI module-size cap after Gerrit 1796, blocking any further edits without prior extraction
completion.py holds four distinct concerns (orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug-screen DET layer, verdict reconciliation) that should split along call-graph seams into separate modules

completion_recovery.py holds three distinct concerns (criteria contract, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) that should decompose into dedicated modules while preserving public re-export facades
the refactor must maintain behavior equivalence, keep documented __all__ seams stable for imports/monkeypatching in consuming code (gate_ops, tests), and route internal consumers to new module homes
all moved symbols must remain patchable at their original dotted paths via re-export facades or must be swept+repointed in consuming test monkeypatch/patch targets to prevent orphaned references
